title.quote: Robust Knowledge Unlearning via Mechanistic Localizations
title.justification: Title as given at the top of the paper.
title.value: Robust Knowledge Unlearning via Mechanistic Localizations

extractions.description: The paper studies machine unlearning in large language models, comparing localization methods (Causal Tracing, Attribution Patching, manual mechanistic interpretability, random, all-MLPs, nonlocalized) combined with localized fine-tuning and weight masking on Gemma-7B, evaluated on Sports Facts unlearning tasks with standard, MCQ, adversarial relearning, latent probing, and MMLU evaluations.

type.quote: Our experiments demonstrate that manual mechanistic unlearning outperforms all other automated localization and nonlocalized unlearning approaches.
type.justification: The paper runs experiments on Gemma-7B with multiple localization/unlearning configurations and reports accuracy tables and figures.

name.quote: Methods for machine unlearning in large language models seek to remove undesirable knowledge or capabilities without compromising general language modeling performance.
name.justification: The paper proposes and evaluates unlearning methods for LLMs.

name.quote: This work investigates the use of mechanistic interpretability to improve the precision and effectiveness of unlearning.
name.justification: The paper uses and advances interpretability-based localization and suggests unlearning as a testbed for interpretability methods.

name.quote: Large language models (LLMs) often learn to encode undesirable knowledge
name.justification: Setting is large language models and factual recall tasks.

name.quote: This paper advances the fields of interpretability and unlearning, both of which are relevant for ensuring the safety, privacy, and fairness of models.
name.justification: Paper frames unlearning as relevant to safety, privacy, fairness.
